source_behavior: CommitIsOnRefsDlg::GetRefsThread loads completion if m_bRefsLoaded is false before testing the revision; ignores GetRefList status and sets the flag. PreTranslateMessage F5 clears that flag. Ordinary queries reuse completion.
implemented: Separate read-only completion API supports unborn/empty/invalid initial UI entry independently of commit resolution.
Native caches successful or empty/failed completion per dialog, queries containment without rereading completion, and invalidates on F5.
F5 preserves entered revision; adding a reference updates containment but does not change completion until explicit refresh.
Completion failure does not block resolving a typed commit; F5 retries the completion read.
Owned cancellation/generation guards reject cancellation-ignoring completion replies after replacement or forced close.
